editorial: Rex is the Queen's favorite corgi, living the high life at Buckingham Palace. He's spoiled, arrogant, and loved above all the other dogs. But when he causes a big mess during a dinner with the US President, he's sent away and ends up lost on the streets of London. Now he has to survive, make friends, and find his way back home. It's a fun, colorful adventure with plenty of laughs for kids and adults alike. The animation is bright and lively, and the story moves at a quick pace that keeps little ones engaged. There are some genuinely sweet moments about friendship and loyalty, plus a few silly jokes that land well. On the downside, the humor can be a bit crude at times, and the plot follows a pretty familiar path. Still, if you're looking for a lighthearted family movie night, this one delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Rex faces off against the villainous dog Charlie, who betrayed him earlier. With help from his new friends, including a scrappy street dog named Wanda, Rex proves his bravery and loyalty. The Queen realizes how much she misses him and welcomes him back to the palace. Rex returns home a changed dog, humbler and kinder, and even makes peace with the other corgis. The movie ends on a warm, happy note with Rex back by the Queen's side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures with cute dogs and light humor.
